Marinated Chicken Skewers
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, March 18, 2010 - 1:16am

Ingredients




Chicken tenders
Fresh ginger
Fresh garlic
Orange juice
Molasses
Soy sauce
Ground cumin to taste

Preparation

1 Skewer chicken tenders and place in a flat food storage container. Roughly chop ginger and garlic and add to chicken. Add orange juice, molasses, and soy sauce to cover chicken. Let marinate in refrigerator for 24 hours. 2 Remove skewers from marinade and sprinkle with ground cumin. Grill to cook.
